description: This file defines an abstract class AbstractThingProxyActor which extends AbstractProxyActor and handles various command and signal messages related to 'things' in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It sets up message handling behavior for commands like DevOps commands, RetrieveThings, and other signals, forwarding them appropriately to actor references.

classes.name: AbstractThingProxyActor
classes.description: An abstract actor class for handling commands and signals related to 'things' in Ditto, forwarding them to appropriate handlers or actors.

methods.name: AbstractThingProxyActor
methods.description: Constructor initializing actor references and setting up the aggregator proxy actor.

methods.name: addCommandBehaviour
methods.description: Defines how to handle incoming command and signal messages, forwarding or processing as appropriate.

methods.name: forwardToConciergeService
methods.description: Forwards signals to the concierge forwarder actor.
